content:
anya: Kicked off nova-40b quant bring-up across us-central / eu-north / ap-sg. Running FP16/BF16/INT8/FP8 sweeps. Calib=8000, seq=2048, batch=4. Observed odd layernorm drift on FP8 in APAC L40. Anyone seen LN-negative bias before?

benchbot: auto-bench summary (calib=8k, batch=4, seq=2048)
```
Region: us-central (H100)
  FP16  p50/p95/p99: 38/70/105 ms  | throughput: 120k toks/s | quality delta vs FP16-baseline: +0.0%
  INT8  p50/p95/p99: 28/54/95 ms   | throughput: 165k toks/s | quality delta: +0.4%
  FP8   p50/p95/p99: 26/52/100 ms  | throughput: 178k toks/s | quality delta: +0.6%
  recommended kernel: triton-fused-kv-v5 (H100)

Region: eu-north (A100)
  FP16  p50/p95/p99: 52/90/140 ms  | throughput: 88k toks/s  | quality delta: +0.0%
  INT8  p50/p95/p99: 40/82/130 ms  | throughput: 115k toks/s | quality delta: +1.0%
  FP8   p50/p95/p99: 44/95/210 ms  | throughput: 108k toks/s  | quality delta: +4.5% (LN skew on some evals)
  recommended kernel: cutlass-fp8-v3 (monitor LN)

Region: ap-sg (L40)
  FP16  p50/p95/p99: 60/115/230 ms  | throughput: 70k toks/s  | quality delta: +0.0%
  INT8  p50/p95/p99: 48/100/185 ms  | throughput: 95k toks/s  | quality delta: +2.1%
  FP8   p50/p95/p99: 46/160/420 ms  | throughput: 98k toks/s  | quality delta: +9.8% (layernorm negative bias observed)
  recommended kernel: cutlass-fp8-l40-tuned (BUT: gated until QC)
```

anya: bench details: calib set=8k mixed (chat, longform, code, summarization), seed=2025. Quant flags: per-channel scaling=ON, symmetric weights, blockwise-fp8 enabled, clip=median. The APAC failure only reproduces with per-channel + blockwise.

matt: Can you paste the exact bench command and the quant lib commit/flags? Need to add to reproducibility notes.

anya:
``
# bench runner snippet
./bench_runner --model nova-40b --quant fp8 --calib 8000 --calib-seed 2025 \
  --kernel cutlass-fp8-l40-tuned --per-channel true --blockwise true --clip median \
  --pcq-bias-correction false --ln-fold true --batch 4 --seq 2048 --region ap-sg
```

felix: I repro locally on L40. FP8 path shows negative offset after layernorm in decoder layers for long contexts (>1024). For translation eval (en->de) we saw perplexity +12% and chrF drop ~1.3. Applying per-output bias correction (pcq-bias-correction=ON) cuts perp delta to ~2.6%.

rachel: Try turning layernorm-fold off and enable bias-correction, re-run and paste numbers. I'll add a LN-bias unit test to quant CI if we can get failing sample ids.

benchbot: re-run (pcq-bias-correction=ON, ln-fold=OFF) completed on ap-sg L40:
```
AP-SG L40 FP8 (pcq-bias-correction=ON, ln-fold=OFF):
  p50/p95/p99: 48/110/160 ms  | throughput: 90k toks/s | quality delta: +2.8% (perp)
  tail improvement: p99 down from 420ms -> 160ms
  cost: +6-12ms median vs previous FP8, throughput -8%
```

anya: So conclusion: FP8 perf gains are real on L40, but default quant pipeline (per-channel + blockwise + ln-fold) produces LN bias in APAC HW profile. Bias-correction helps but adds latency. We should gate FP8 in APAC until we: (1) add LN-bias calibration check, (2) enable pcq-bias-correction by default in FP8 path for L40, (3) include targeted evals in canary.

matt: Proposed rollout: enable FP8 canary 15% in US/EU (H100/A100) with kernels triton-fused-kv-v5 & cutlass-fp8-v3. APAC (L40) -> blocked until CI + bias fixes. Add automated LN-bias check (threshold 1.5% perp) on calibration set.

felix: +1. Also add a small smoke eval: 1k chat prompts and 3 safety metrics; if any metric regresses >2% fail canary.

rachel: I'll add LN-bias unit test to quant CI and create a guarded flag fp8.apac.gated=true in rollout config. @anya can you upload failing sample ids to #eng-ml-samples?

anya: uploaded sample ids and short dev repro guide in #eng-ml-samples. cheers.

matt: marking FP8 APAC as gated; FP8 US/EU canary 15%. Will follow up in rollout doc. :thumbsup:
